title: Agents need something to read
thesis: Every vendor shipped an agent this autumn. An agent is only as good as what it can read about the content. Grounding in facts fixes a made-up cast list, but a request like 'tense but not violent, under 100 minutes' needs to know how the scenes feel.
whyNow: At least 13 of the companies the radar tracks pitched agents at or since IBC, from Gracenote's MCP server and entertainment SLM to ThinkAnalytics and ContentWise putting agents into editorial tools. Ad buying is going agentic too (Magnite's orchestration layer), and those agents will read structured content data. The question for buyers has moved from 'do you have an agent?' to 'what does it understand?'.
